verdict.rationale: BVNK documents wallet creation for both crypto and fiat via Portal or API, a Transfers v3 API for wallet-to-wallet currency conversion, rules linking fiat virtual accounts to crypto addresses for automated fiat-to-crypto transfers, and dashboard/website features like 'use your fiat balance to send stablecoins, or fund in stablecoins and pay out in fiat.' This covers internal rebalancing between fiat and stablecoin balances end-to-end via API and Portal. Missing for 10: a dedicated finance-lead-facing reconciliation/reporting walkthrough tying transfers to treasury workflows, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
